$comment: Canon source per hull (#423): tier A Memory Alpha, B Memory Beta or other licensed work, G Memory Gamma or the STO wiki, none the mod's own design. Reviewed from pipeline/canon_check.py's lookups and the HWRM-Continuum wiki's Canon Verification Results. Structures with no class (shipyards, miners, turrets, outposts, Construction Bees) are left out.

fed_ENT_AND_kumari.note: The Kumari is the best-known ship of the class. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 37.

fed_ENT_AND_miklon.note: From Star Trek: Armada, as the Andorian Miklon; no wiki page of its own.

fed_ENT_bonaventure.note: The first ship with warp drive, per Scotty.

fed_ENT_challenger.note: On screen as an unnamed Earth class; Eaglemoss calls it the Warp Delta, and Memory Beta the Ganges class. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 82.

fed_ENT_intrepid.note: Eaglemoss covers it as the United Earth Starfleet Intrepid. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 44.

fed_ENT_TEL_tgarim.note: Eaglemoss covers the Tellarite cruiser. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 115.

fed_ENT_VUL_cruiser.note: The design is from the fan film Star Trek: Axanar, not the mod's own; the name is the Vulcan ship seen in ENT.

fed_ENT_yorktown.note: A United Earth battleship in licensed works.

fed_ENT_maco.note: MACO is a canon organisation, but no vessel of theirs has this name.

kng_ENT_d4.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection special issue 4.

kng_ENT_k5.note: Memory Beta files the K5 under the V's'talo class.

kng_ENT_stinger.note: Memory Beta files the Stinger under the D'esta Kar class.

kng_ENT_goroth.note: Named after the Klingon captain of ENT "Bounty"; the class is the mod's own. His transport is Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 71.

kng_ENT_flagship.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

rom_ENT_chhavran.note: Named after Ch'Havran, the Romulans' own name for Remus; the class is the mod's own.

rom_ENT_chrihan.note: Named after Ch'Rihan, the Romulans' own name for Romulus; the class is the mod's own.

rom_ENT_dreadnought.note: A Gregory Jein design, not the mod's own; Dark Sentinel built the mod's version of it. Named after Tellus, a Vulcan warrior of Surak's time.

rom_ENT_erehin.note: The warp-7 stardrive prototype from the novel Kobayashi Maru; no wiki page of its own.

rom_ENT_fighter.note: Named after the set'leth, a Romulan animal; the craft is the mod's own.

rom_ENT_flagship.note: Admiral Valdore's flagship in the Earth–Romulan War novels.

rom_ENT_jorek.note: Named after S'Vath Jo'rek, who unified Romulus; the class is the mod's own.

rom_ENT_karatek.note: Named after Karatek, a Reman of the Vulcan's Soul novels; the class is the mod's own.

rom_ENT_pontilus.note: Named after Pontilus, the first Praetor; the class is the mod's own.

rom_ENT_trehu.note: From Mark Farinas's fan comic Star Trek – The Webcomic, where it's an Enterprise-era Romulan heavy; not the mod's own. Named after Vriha t'Rehu, a Romulan empress.

thl_ENT_webspinner.note: The Tholian Web Spinner. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 129.

fed_TOS_archer.note: A Federation scout in licensed works.

fed_TOS_ares.note: From the fan film Star Trek: Axanar, set in the Four Years War; not the mod's own.

fed_TOS_coyote.note: Demon Renegade's F-FT interceptor, a fan design.

fed_TOS_detroyat.note: A fast heavy destroyer from fan works (Star Trek Expanded).

fed_TOS_DY750.note: Extends the canon DY line; the design is the mod's own.

fed_TOS_lightning.note: No Federation class of this name; Memory Beta's Lightning class is an Orion ship.

fed_TOS_mcquarrie.note: After Ralph McQuarrie's concept art; contributed by Major Stress.

fed_TOS_resourcecontroller.note: The Antares (NCC-501) is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 63.

kng_TOS_bomber.note: A Klingon attack shuttle, a fan design.

kng_TOS_d12.note: Memory Alpha files the D12 with the Bird-of-Prey.

kng_TOS_d3.note: Memory Beta lists more than one D3 class.

kng_TOS_flagship.note: Koloth's D7 in "The Trouble with Tribbles".

kng_TOS_k30.note: Memory Beta files the K30 under the K'nel class.

kng_TOS_predator.note: Memory Beta files the Klingon Predator with the D4 design.

rom_TOS_d7.note: The Romulans flew D7s in the late 2260s. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 67.

rom_TOS_flagship.note: Named after Gal Gath'thong, a place on Romulus; the flagship is the mod's own.

rom_TOS_praetor.note: A small ship, despite the name.

zzz_TOS_planetkiller.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection special issue 17.

fed_TES_flagship.note: The Terran Empire's flagship is the mod's own.

fed_TMP_ambassador.note: The Enterprise-C is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 46.

fed_TMP_constellation.note: The Stargazer is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 19.

fed_TMP_enterprise.note: The refitted Enterprise. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 2.

fed_TMP_flagship.note: The Excelsior-class Enterprise-B. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 40.

fed_TMP_regula.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection special issue 24.

fed_TMP_starbase.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection special issue 15.

grn_TMP_grendel.note: The Gorn command dreadnought of Star Fleet Battles and Starfleet Command.

grn_TMP_heavycruiser.note: Named for its size: Memory Beta's Balaur is a 25th-century Star Trek Online dreadnought, while the mod's is a TMP heavy cruiser.

grn_TMP_fighter.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its fighter role; the name is the mod's own.

grn_TMP_destroyer.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its destroyer role; the name is the mod's own.

grn_TMP_frigate.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its frigate role; the name is the mod's own.

grn_TMP_lightcruiser.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its light cruiser role; the name is the mod's own.

grn_TMP_flagship.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its battleship role; the name is the mod's own. Gornar is the Gorn homeworld.

grn_TMP_scout.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its scout role; the name is the mod's own.

grn_TMP_bomber.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its bomber role; the name is the mod's own.

grn_TMP_repairship.note: A Gorn hull from Starfleet Command II: Empires at War, in its repair tender role; the name is the mod's own.

kng_TMP_bomber.note: The Klingon fighter of Starfleet Command II.

kng_TMP_flagship.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

kng_TMP_kleev.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

kng_TMP_nuqpah.note: The nearest canon name is the NuQ'Duj scout.

kng_TMP_tamhey.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

rom_TMP_fighter.note: The Romulan fighter of Starfleet Command II.

rom_TMP_flagship.note: A Firehawk, the Romulan heavy cruiser of Star Fleet Battles and Starfleet Command. Her name is the Decius's, the holographic warbird of TNG "Future Imperfect".

rom_TMP_starglider.note: Memory Beta files the Starglider under the Vadaso Stelri class.

rom_TMP_stormbird.note: The Stormbird is the Romulan name for their D7s.

rom_TMP_whitewind.note: Memory Beta files the Whitewind under the Aye Mosaram class.

brg_TNG_diamond.note: On screen, the Borg Queen's ship has this shape. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 109.

brn_TNG_chelgrett.note: Eaglemoss covers the Breen warship. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 69.

car_TNG_flagship.note: A Keldon-class battleship in licensed works.

car_TNG_mogrund.note: Named after the Mogrund, a creature of Cardassian myth; the class is the mod's own.

car_TNG_bomber.note: Named after Neeron, a figure of Cardassian myth; the craft is the mod's own.

dom_TNG_bugship.note: The Jem'Hadar attack ship, or bug ship. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 13.

dom_TNG_fighter.note: Another maker's design, not the mod's own; Dark Sentinel built an updated model of it. The canon Jem'Hadar fighter is the attack ship.

dom_TNG_virulent.note: A fan design, named after the IKV Virulent of the Starfleet Command games.

fed_TNG_brisbane.note: An easter egg, listed only on 28 July.

fed_TNG_constructionship.note: Named after the USS Fleming; its role here is the mod's.

fed_TNG_fighter.note: The Federation attack fighter. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 68.

fed_TNG_intrepid.note: The Voyager is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 6.

fed_TNG_nova.note: The Equinox is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 15.

fed_TNG_repairship.note: Named after the canon Antares-class freighter; its role here is the mod's.

fed_TNG_sabre.note: Spelt Sabre here, the Australian way. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 56.

kng_TNG_E7.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it. E7 is a Star Fleet Battles hull code.

kng_TNG_kron.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

kng_TNG_kvort.note: The K'vort is the larger Bird-of-Prey. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 35.

rom_TNG_bomber.note: A kitbash of the Starfleet Command II Romulan fighter (the Scythe); also flown in Star Trek: Invasion.

rom_TNG_norexan.note: The screen design is the Valdore type; Memory Beta calls it the Mogai class, and the card game the Norexan. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 31.

und_TNG_nicor.note: Memory Beta calls this class the Nicor. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 43.

vth_TNG_citadel.note: The Voth city ship from VOY "Distant Origin"; Citadel is the mod's name. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 70.

vth_TNG_palisade.note: From VOY "Distant Origin". Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 62.

vth_TNG_bastille.note: A Star Trek Online temporal science vessel.

vth_TNG_stronghold.note: A Star Trek Online dreadnought; no wiki page of its own.

kng_TMP_vodleh.note: A design from Star Trek: Starfleet Command, not the mod's own (Star Trek Online's later voDleH is a different ship).

kng_TNG_suqjagh.note: A boarding vessel from the Star Trek: Armada games; no wiki page of its own.
